name: team-inbox
description: Team Inbox for Claude Code. When your session is blocked on something only a teammate knows, file an ask to them; their Claude tells them at the start of their next session, and the answer flows back into yours. Asks live in a shared claude.ai Artifact your team owns: no server, no repo, no database to run.

inbox.title: Inbox link
inbox.description: The claude.ai link of your team's Team Inbox page (https://claude.ai/...). Your team lead gets it from /team-inbox:setup.

reminders.title: Session-start check
reminders.description: first-of-day checks the inbox in your first Claude Code session each day; every-session checks in every new session; off never checks automatically (use /team-inbox:inbox).
